prior_credit.previous_work: Earlier unreviewed OCR-derived p83 B or p98 A1 body candidates, including frozen p73 retrieval copies, are explicitly retained. Source review and exact repair accounting are the present contribution; newly readable p98 A2/B do not establish universal priority.

limits: A2 and B are132/133-position near-repeated second parts with their own264/266-coordinate frames. No common-length model, coordinate insertion or deletion is applied.
NUMEHR remains in both second parts; the raw place spellings NIKILJEW and NIKOLAJEW remain distinct. Neither spelling is silently repaired.
FECH, ROEM, GROSS, BVG and the reference digits remain literal source labels; no codebook meaning or numerical key correction is asserted.
Four A2/B letter repairs are supported by directly observed matching plaintext pairs in the other witness, separately from the three A1 ordinary-word repairs.
Earlier A2/B OCR candidates omitted the first source row and were unreadable. Retranscribing the complete printed bodies is not counted as insertion into the source.
Round trips and exact edit counts establish compatibility, not unique historical wording.
Reference digits remain published key labels. No new digit permutation or codebook meaning is assigned.
